text: 国家发改委、国家能源局印发《“十五五”新型储能实施方案》。方案提出，锚定2030年前碳达峰目标，建设能源强国，坚持高质量发展主线，统筹发展和安全，综合平衡各类电源、电网及调节能力的关系，巩固提升新型储能产业核心竞争力，全面支撑新型能源体系和新型电力系统建设。到2030年，新型储能由规模化发展阶段步入市场化发展阶段，全国新型储能装机规模达到3亿千瓦，平均储能时长3小时左右。
text_en: The National Development and Reform Commission and the National Energy Administration issued the "15th Five-Year Plan" Implementation Plan for New-Type Energy Storage. The plan proposes to anchor the goal of peaking carbon emissions before 2030, build an energy powerhouse, adhere to the main line of high-quality development, coordinate development and security, comprehensively balance the relationship among various power sources, power grids and regulation capabilities, consolidate and enhance the core competitiveness of the new-type energy storage industry, and fully support the building of a new energy system and a new power system. By 2030, new-type energy storage will move from the large-scale development stage to the market-based development stage, with nationwide installed new-type energy storage capacity reaching 300 million kilowatts and an average storage duration of about 3 hours.
